scope: Complete 30-page demo suite spanning application, account, marketing, commerce and recovery, built with shared Shine components. Real backend integrations remain the consuming application’s responsibility; every demo is labeled and locally functional.
acceptance: Project creation validation, inspect and status move
Notification read state and related record navigation
Team filter, profile and validated add
Calendar event creation and date navigation
Billing plan changes and invoice export
Marketing contact form and pricing selection
Clearly simulated login, signup and recovery; no real credentials requested
Store product choices, cart quantity/removal, checkout validation and confirmation
Every page: desktop/mobile/dark keyboard and error-free interactions
